item.title: What went WRONG vs. Tennessee? 😮 Is it TOO LATE for Alabama?! w/ CHRISTIAN MILLER!
item.author: Alabama Crimson Tide on AL.com
item.description:
Things didn't go as planned in Knoxville. Tennessee's defense dominated Alabama in a 26-10 beatdown in Neyland Stadium. Keelon Russell and the offense looked lost. The defense did all it could but got pushed around in the second half. So, what happened? Former Alabama linebacker and captain Christian Miller joins Ben Flanagan to break down Alabama's second straight loss and Ryan Grubb's offensive gameplan, understand what went wrong, and look ahead to this week's home game against Texas A&M. Does Alabama still have a shot at the College Football Playoff? And what about former Alabama football players who are publicly critical of the program?
